tools.name: tool_smith
tools.description: Call with no parameters (or only filters, e.g. read*) to list the saved functions of the library; each entry starts with the call expression to type, fn.<name>(input), then the file and description. Give code to execute a TypeScript function body in a child process, waiting up to block_ms. Write output with console.log: stdout is the result of the script. return is optional and only for structured values; a returned value is shown in a [result] block, and a body without return gives no [result] block; input is bound to the input variable. If the script is still running you get an id and it keeps going: use the async tool to wait for, list, inspect or stop it. Saved functions are reusable files called as fn.<name>(input) inside a function body. The script runs with full interpreter privileges: the nested tools list, the profile's allow and deny limit only the tools.* bridge, not what the script itself can do.

filters.description: Only with no code: list the saved functions whose name or description matches every filter, case-insensitive. A filter with * or ? is a wildcard pattern (read*, *file*); any other is a substring.

code.description: TypeScript async function body to run. Write output with console.log; return is optional.

input.description: JSON data bound to the input variable of the function body.

block_ms.description: Most time to block for the result. If the script is still running an id is returned; collect it with the async tool.
